_comment: cz-css-1012: Multi-Stage Build for CSS Processing — nginx.conf Injection via SSM.
The nginx.conf used in the multi-stage CSS container is stored in AWS SSM Parameter
Store and injected into the ECS Fargate task at runtime via the `secrets` field,
enabling environment-specific routing rules without rebuilding the image.
cz-css-1010: ECS Fargate Sidecar Container for Asset Sync to S3 on Task Start.
This task definition snippet adds a sidecar container (essential: false) that syncs
extracted static assets (e.g. splash-bg.png, extracted from the previously inlined
base64 CSS data URI in old-theme.css) to S3 at task initialization.
cz-css-1006: Development CSS Files in Production Container — CSS Validation Sidecar.
A short-lived CSS validation sidecar container (essential: false, dependsOn COMPLETE)
scans the application image for development CSS files (styles.dev.css, debug.css,
test styles) before the main application container is allowed to start.
If any dev CSS files are detected the sidecar exits with a non-zero code, preventing
the main container from starting and surfacing the violation in ECS task logs.
The sidecar uses the ECS task IAM role to authenticate with S3 — no credentials are
hardcoded. Assets are always in sync with the running application version without a
separate CI step.
Required ECS task environment variables (inject via ECS task definition or AWS Secrets Manager):
ASSETS_S3_BUCKET  - S3 bucket name where assets are stored (e.g. my-app-assets)
ASSETS_S3_PREFIX  - S3 key prefix for assets (e.g. dashboard-app/images)
CDN_BASE_URL      - CloudFront distribution URL (e.g. https://d1234abcd.cloudfront.net)
This is referenced in old-theme.css for .splash background URL.
Required SSM Parameter Store entries (cz-css-1012):
/dashboard-app/nginx-conf  - Full nginx.conf content for the runtime container.
Stored as a SecureString or String parameter.
Injected as NGINX_CONF via the `secrets` field below.
Required IAM permissions for the ECS task execution role:
ssm:GetParameters on arn:aws:ssm:<region>:<account>:parameter/dashboard-app/*
kms:Decrypt (if SSM parameter is a SecureString encrypted with a customer KMS key)
Required IAM permissions for the ECS task role:
s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::${ASSETS_S3_BUCKET}/${ASSETS_S3_PREFIX}/*
s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::${ASSETS_S3_BUCKET}/${ASSETS_S3_PREFIX}/*

secrets._comment: cz-css-1012: nginx.conf injected from SSM Parameter Store at task startup. The entrypoint script writes this value to /etc/nginx/nginx.conf before nginx starts, enabling environment-specific routing rules without rebuilding the container image.
secrets.name: NGINX_CONF

containerDefinitions.name: css-dev-file-validator
_comment: cz-css-1006: Short-lived CSS validation sidecar (essential: false).
Scans the shared application assets volume for development CSS files
(styles.dev.css, *.dev.css, debug.css, test*.css) before the main
application container is allowed to start (dependsOn COMPLETE).
If any dev CSS files are found the sidecar exits with code 1, which
causes the ECS task to fail and surfaces the violation in CloudWatch Logs.
This enforces that no debug/development CSS styling reaches production,
preventing container image bloat and accidental exposure of debug styles.
essential: false — the sidecar exits after validation; the task lifecycle
is governed by the main application container.
command: set -e && echo '[cz-css-1006] Starting CSS dev-file validation...' && ASSET_DIR=/app/assets && DEV_CSS_PATTERNS='styles.dev.css debug.css test.css' && FOUND=0 && for pattern in $DEV_CSS_PATTERNS; do FILES=$(find $ASSET_DIR -name "$pattern" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILES" ]; then echo "[cz-css-1006] ERROR: Development CSS file detected in production container: $FILES"; FOUND=1; fi; done && FILES_DEV=$(find $ASSET_DIR -name '*.dev.css' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILES_DEV" ]; then echo "[cz-css-1006] ERROR: Development CSS file (*.dev.css) detected in production container: $FILES_DEV"; FOUND=1; fi && FILES_TEST=$(find $ASSET_DIR -name 'test*.css' 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILES_TEST" ]; then echo "[cz-css-1006] ERROR: Test CSS file (test*.css) detected in production container: $FILES_TEST"; FOUND=1; fi && if [ "$FOUND" -eq 1 ]; then echo '[cz-css-1006] FAIL: Dev/debug CSS files found. Blocking main container startup. Remove dev CSS files from the image and ensure .dockerignore excludes assets/styles/styles.dev.css'; exit 1; fi && echo '[cz-css-1006] PASS: No development or debug CSS files detected. Main container cleared to start.'

containerDefinitions.name: asset-sync-sidecar
_comment: cz-css-1010: Sidecar container (essential: false) that syncs extracted static assets
to S3 at ECS task initialization using the task IAM role.
Decodes splash-bg.png.b64 (extracted from the previously inlined base64 CSS data URI)
to splash-bg.png and uploads it to S3 under ASSETS_S3_PREFIX/images/.
The main application container depends on this sidecar completing (condition: COMPLETE)
before starting, ensuring assets are always available in S3/CDN when the app starts.
essential: false means the task continues running even if this sidecar exits after sync.
command: set -e && echo 'Starting asset sync to S3...' && ASSET_DIR=/app/assets/images && S3_TARGET=s3://${ASSETS_S3_BUCKET}/${ASSETS_S3_PREFIX}/images && echo 'Decoding splash-bg.png from base64...' && base64 -d ${ASSET_DIR}/splash-bg.png.b64 > /tmp/splash-bg.png && echo 'Uploading splash-bg.png to S3...' && aws s3 cp /tmp/splash-bg.png ${S3_TARGET}/splash-bg.png --content-type image/png --cache-control 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' && echo 'Asset sync complete. splash-bg.png uploaded to '${S3_TARGET}'/splash-bg.png'

volumes.name: app-assets
volumes._comment: Shared volume populated by the main app container's Docker image assets directory
